title: Map labelling #5
topic: wildlife park · sports centre · museum · botanical garden
context:
Narrator: Map 1. The wildlife park.
Guide: Welcome to the wildlife park. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the bird aviary is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the gift shop is the first building on your left.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the first-aid post is the first building on your right.
Guide: The picnic area is directly behind the gift shop, at the back of the site.
Guide: The ticket office is directly behind the bird aviary, at the back of the site.
Guide: The café is directly behind the first-aid post, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 2. The sports centre.
Guide: Welcome to the sports centre. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the juice bar is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the squash courts. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the swimming pool is the first building on your right.
Guide: The creche is directly behind the squash courts, at the back of the site.
Guide: The weights room is right next to the creche, on its left side.
Guide: The reception is right next to the creche, on its right side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 3. The museum.
Guide: Welcome to the museum. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the gift counter is the first building on your right.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the costume gallery is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the temporary exhibition is the first building on your left.
Guide: The archive room is directly behind the costume gallery, at the back of the site.
Guide: The dinosaur hall is right next to the archive room, on its left side.
Guide: The cafeteria is right next to the archive room, on its right side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 4. The botanical garden.
Guide: Welcome to the botanical garden. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the pond is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the souvenir stall. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the visitor centre. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: The rose garden is directly behind the pond, at the back of the site.
Guide: The tea room is right next to the rose garden, on its right side.
Guide: The sculpture lawn is directly behind the visitor centre, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
